<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant M peak with a ~10 % M+1 peak and rapidly decreasing higher‑mass peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da—the only element that can be definitively identified is carbon, whose 13C isotope produces exactly this pattern. No characteristic chlorine, bromine, or sulfur isotope signatures are present.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
